faq.0.question: Do I need to install Node.js or Pi first?
faq.0.answer: No. Community desktop builds bundle Pi and Node.js / npm / npx. Set up your model provider and start. Building this website from source separately requires Node.js.
faq.1.question: Does it replace Pi Coding Agent?
faq.1.answer: No. Native Pi remains the default agent execution engine. Pi-Harness adds a visual workspace, operational controls, recovery and orchestration around it.
faq.2.question: What is the difference between Harness Plugins and Pi Extensions?
faq.2.answer: Pi Extensions extend native agent behavior; Harness Plugins extend run observation, evaluation, export, and team templates. Plugin SDK v1.0.0 ships with Pi-Harness v2.2.6 and later; check each release for packaged availability.
faq.3.question: Why do macOS or Windows show security warnings?
faq.3.answer: Community installers may lack Apple Developer ID notarization or Windows code signing. Download only from official GitHub Releases, verify the checksums and follow OS-provided security prompts. Do not disable security protections.
